snippet.title: COCOBOY - Demo Disc Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
COCOBOY is a 2D puzzle platformer within a 3D retro gaming simulation. Hack an ’80s cult classic with modded abilities, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour a 2005 gaming forum where a peculiar fandom takes root. 

COCOBOY Demo Disc is the game's free demo, representing the first year of development. The demo will be launching January 30, 2026!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864040/COCOBOY_Demo_Disc
Itch.io: https://knairda.itch.io/cocoboy
